decisions.rationale: SendAsync adds each accepted message to _pending with Deadline=now+MessageTtl, and the retransmit loop delays by RetransmitInterval then iterates _pending.ToArray(), removing only expired entries. Repo test search found no multi-message/soak test of this pending scan; only single-message TTL/delivery cases.

FailoverTests constructs FakeFabric, cuts links, and asserts TryNextHop/Snapshot cost/unreachable. The file contains no SendAsync, inbox, frame, or delivery assertion, so these tests prove route reconvergence/unreachability only, not message delivery across reconvergence.
